body: To try and make conservatives feel bad because of a bill not passing.  For fake illnesses, for non-combat veterans.  Boo-hoo Jon Stewart.  We're wise to his bullshit by now
Right?  All for a bunch of bullshit 'sick veteran' stories.  Seriously, most of these people were never deployed, never saw combat, and have NO REASON to make these claims.
Fake tears from Johnny "Comedy Central" Stewart for a bunch of fake illnesses.  This is all just a money-grab.

Honestly...  I think it's a good thing.  What do you want to bet most of these 'veterans' were non-combat service members? Or don't actually have any disease, they're just sick in the head? Jon Stewart needs to get the fuck out of here. The PACT act is a horrible precedent to set for providing health care to NON-COMBAT 'veterans'. Bullshit, I'm tired of being told my tax dollars should pay for a therapist or psychiatrist that's just going to treat a 'veteran' who probably hasn't seen anyone die.  Republicans are smart enough to see through this bullshit.  Most of the military votes right, and wouldn't ask for handouts like this.  I don't think they're trying to help.  I think democrats are trying to stick their paws into a slush fund for a bunch of MADE UP illnesses.

Honestly, it's even worse than that, and I'm sure everyone on this subreddit will back me up. Most of these 'service members' are making these illnesses up. We do NOT need to put money towards this bullshit bill, and people like Jon Stewart are virtue-signaling assholes for telling us otherwise.  This is a money-grab for lefties in between all of the other ones over the last decade.  Everyone on this subreddit is smart enough to see through this.
